title: Surrogate-based categorical neighborhoods for mixed-variable blackbox optimization
summary: In simulation-based engineering, design choices are often obtained following the optimization of complex blackbox models. These models frequently involve mixed-variable domains with quantitative and categorical variables. Unlike quantitative variables, categorical variables lack an inherent structure, which makes them difficult to handle, especially in the presence of constraints. This work proposes a systematic approach to structure and model categorical variables in constrained mixed-variable blackbox optimization.
